title: Fine-Tuning Safety Tax: Quantifying Alignment Degradation from Benign Domain Adaptation

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Highly practical: if benign fine-tuning consistently degrades alignment, this is a concern for every organization that fine-tunes. Directly informs deployment policies and safety re-evaluation requirements.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Fine-tuning on benign datasets is standard and well-supported by libraries. Safety benchmark evaluation (TruthfulQA, refusal tests) uses existing tools. Medium compute suffices for 7B models.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Could be scoped to 2-3 benign domains on one model, measuring alignment at a few checkpoints. Multiple domains add breadth but the per-domain evaluation is straightforward. Tight but feasible in 30 hours.
